verdict.rationale: Conta Simples lists an 'Área de aprovações' (approvals area) among its payment features, so it has its own approval capability. Nothing in the evidence describes how approvals are configured: there is no mention of multi-level chains, budget-owner or finance roles, delegation, or escalation. Missing for 10: documented multi-step approval chains (manager, budget owner, finance), delegation of approvals, escalation when approvers do not act, any detail on configuring approval rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build multi-step approval chains — manager, budget owner, finance — with delegation and escalation when approvers sit on requests

citations.quote: Pagamentos em lote Área de aprovações
